notes: RGSS2 line: .rgss2a archive, Game.rvproj project marker, or the Game.ini Library=RGSS2xx declaration. Listed after vxace so the more specific RGSS3 evidence wins first.

saves.source: The stock RGSS2 save scripts write Save<n>.rvdata beside Game.exe; mkxp-z src/config.cpp:456-459 names the .rvdata extension; games may move them into a Save folder (seen in a shipped RGSS3 game)
